repositoryLevelConfiguration.message: fix(deploy): disable automatic Git publication for the release repository
repositoryLevelConfiguration.effect: Git-triggered builds (preview AND production) are disabled at the repository level. Every push after this commit produces ZERO deployments; the current production deployment was therefore published manually, not by Git.

latestDeployment.note: Created after deploymentEnabled=false (2026-10-02) → manual publication (not Git-triggered; consistent with docs/evidence/recuperacao-producao-2026-10-12/captures/vercel-topology.txt: 'push não builda; publicação é manual'). Its /api/health/ready returns 503 postgres unavailable.

rootCauseForNoDeployOnMain: By design: vercel.json sets git.deploymentEnabled=false since commit 0bafaeb (2026-10-02); publication is manual/conditional per ADR-042 and AGENTS.md 'Publication is manual and conditional (C26)'.
